column1: # Two ~1.94MB app slots (ota_0 + ota_1) + otadata so the bootloader can
# swap between the current and the new firmware during an over-the-air
# update. No SPIFFS/LittleFS partition: this firmware stores all settings
# in NVS and embeds the web page in the app image.
# Used by the classic ESP32 (4MB flash) boards
# "huge_app.csv" they would otherwise use. Boards with 8MB/16MB flash keep
